profile.description:
Wan 3.0 generates video clips of 2 to 30 seconds with synchronized native audio, with Standard and Prime (faster) tiers.

Generation modes
- Text-to-video from a prompt alone
- Animate one image, or two images as first and last frame
- Reference mode: combine up to 10 images, 5 video clips, and 5 audio clips, and address them in your prompt as Image 1, Video 1, Audio 1

This bot supports optional parameters for additional customization.

rate_cards.rateMenuMarkdown:
**Wan 3.0 Video Generation Pricing**

Pricing is per second of generated video.

| Tier | Resolution | Rate (USD) | Rate (Points) |
|------|------------|------------|---------------|
| Standard | 480P | $0.070/sec | 2,333 pts/sec |
| Standard | 720P | $0.140/sec | 4,667 pts/sec |
| Standard | 1080P | $0.280/sec | 9,333 pts/sec |
| Prime | 480P | $0.136/sec | 4,533 pts/sec |
| Prime | 720P | $0.280/sec | 9,333 pts/sec |
| Prime | 1080P | $0.560/sec | 18,667 pts/sec |

Requests that include video references are billed for input plus output duration combined.
